premises.text: Huge volumes of photos are shared daily across services, but finding pictures you like is hard
premises.evidence_span: how do you find pictures you like?

premises.text: Skyline organizes real-time photos by matching personal interests collected from social networks to photo streams
Interests come from Facebook likes, Twitter searches/hashtags, and planned Foursquare places—not only people
premises.evidence_span: We connect to your social networks to collect your interests

premises.text: Ingests millions of photos/day from Instagram, TwitPic, YFrog and more into personalized skyline streams
premises.evidence_span: we collect over a million pictures a day from services such as Instagram, TwitPic, and WhyFrog

premises.text: Product surfaces: web/apps, ranking/friends filters, location photos, explore, and back-channel screensaver for events
premises.evidence_span: We are not only launching this as a website, but also as an app, both on iPhone and on Android

premises.text: Monetize via interest/location/time-targeted brand ads plus embeddable widgets with revenue share or ad-free fees
premises.evidence_span: Brands can target an interest, like TechCrunch Disrupt, if they want, combined with location or time

value.text: Everyone gets their own real-time skyline of photos matched to their interests
